name: Authentication audit
description: Audit authentication in any stack: login and recovery flows, credential storage, sessions, tokens and MFA. Use when asked how users or services authenticate, or when a review reaches authentication code.

references.description: Password hashing, key and API-secret storage checks.
Server-side sessions and cookies: creation, rotation, expiry, invalidation.
Bearer, signed and API tokens: signature, claims, expiry, revocation.
